rationale: All initial development slots are terminal and all twelve continuation forecasts completed. Extended material fitting improves the overall development motion error; select it globally, retaining the obstacle-drop regression and unchanged clamps.
Apply the same extended material-fit budget to the analytic control, which retains its explicit oracle constitutive-family advantage.

Retain 40 iterations for native PhysTwin and Spring-Gaus. Their single-clamp 160-iteration controls lowered calibration error but increased vector forecast error by 12.4% and 19.8%, respectively; Spring-Gaus shape error improved. This does not establish convergence or universally optimal budgets. Preserve and report both budgets.
Allow 14400 seconds for held native fits to avoid the original stacked Spring-Gaus 7200-second truncation; record actual successful iterations, failures and wall time.
Retain UniPhy on both drop queries for every drop world, with its documented contact-law and gradient-adapter limitations. Do not convert unsupported families or failed rollouts into accuracy wins.
Freeze before generating any held worlds. Use all six families, 24 worlds and 48 changed-interaction queries; share appearance and report reference-resolution sensitivity.

ours.calibration: Powell: up to 64 evaluations, then up to 128 additional evaluations initialized from the best sealed calibration fit; identical spatial parameterization and bounds; calibration loss selects the final parameters.
ours.material_network: Frozen prior decoder plus independent compressibility extension

analytic-control.calibration: Powell: up to 64 evaluations, then up to 128 additional evaluations initialized from the best sealed calibration fit; identical spatial parameterization and bounds; calibration loss selects the final parameters.

spring-gaus.calibration: Scalar stiffness search (initial value plus at most 12 bounded iterations), then 40 Adam iterations for per-edge stiffness and damping
spring-gaus.adaptation: Author internal force/integrator; common boundary adapter; exact dense KNN compatibility

phystwin.adaptation: Author Warp spring force and sealed-forecast integrator; common boundary adapter; fixed zero damping

uniphy.calibration: 8 fixed-seed latent-centroid initializations, then 8 AdamW iterations
uniphy.adaptation: Released demo pretrained networks and MPM; fixed bowl/sphere collision hooks; optional adjoint bridge
uniphy.contact_law_limit: Native separating-velocity projection differs from the conservative penalty boundary used by the reference and other adapters; report as a capability comparison, not matched contact-law material inference
uniphy.gradient_limit: Short derivative tests remain coordinate-sensitive; disclose adaptation and incomplete qualification
